reason: Provides a quicksight_ocr tool that extracts text from images with local OCR and optionally falls back to configured vision models for broader image understanding.

summaries.zh: 通过本地 OCR 识别图片文字，并可在需要时调用用户配置的视觉模型进行补充分析。
summaries.en: Extracts text from images with local OCR and can optionally use a configured vision model for additional image analysis.

capabilities: Processes local image files or image URLs for OCR and visual analysis
Invokes a local Python OCR process and the modlens CLI
May send images to a user-configured external vision service for fallback analysis
